seo_title: Dessert After Ramen: Mochi Ice Cream at Bakudan Ramen
h1: Dessert After Ramen: Why Mochi Ice Cream Is the Perfect Finish
meta_description: Bakudan Ramen's dessert menu is small and simple: Mochi Ice Cream. Here's what it is and why it works after a hot bowl of ramen.
audience: Diners looking to finish the meal
body_html:
Bakudan's dessert menu isn't extensive — it's one item, Mochi Ice Cream, and that's by design. After a hot, rich bowl of ramen, a small, cold dessert makes more sense than something heavy.

What's Actually on the Plate

Mochi Ice Cream is $5.50, and you choose two flavors from vanilla, strawberry, or green tea. It's a small-format dessert — ice cream wrapped in a soft mochi rice dough shell — meant to be a light finish, not a second course.

Why It Works After Ramen Specifically

A bowl of ramen, especially something rich like Garlic Tonkotsu, is filling on its own. A small cold dessert closes out the meal without adding more heavy food on top of it — which is part of why it's the one dessert item on the menu rather than a longer list.

Picking Flavors

Green tea is the closest flavor to something distinctly Japanese if that's what you're after; vanilla and strawberry are more familiar, safer choices if you're ordering for someone who isn't sure. Since you get to pick two, there's no need to commit to just one.

Ordering It

Mochi Ice Cream is available at all three locations and can be added to any online order alongside your ramen, or ordered at the table.
